performanceGate.rule: Pass when the candidate/baseline geometric mean of paired per-draft priced cost (same model, case and replicate; log ratios averaged within each case, then across cases) is at most 1.000. The case-clustered 95% interval is reported, not required. Any paired draft without a priced cost makes the gate inconclusive. Writer wall time and token counts are information, not criteria.

workEvidence.scope: Self-reported runtime counters, tested separately; never validation outcome evidence.

limitations: Case-clustered percentile bootstrap; repeats, models and judges are not independent cases.
Priced cost uses src/report/prices.json list prices (reported totals where the agent gives one); it is not an invoice.
Writer wall time (service waits and observation overhead included) and token counts are reported as information, not criteria.
Noncomparable validation leaves cost, timing and token differences descriptive; it establishes neither a gain nor a regression.
